    private static void Walk(ReadOnlySpan<byte> adu, FrameDirection direction, int? requestAddress, List<FrameField>? fields, out ParsedAdu? parsed, out string? error)
    {
        parsed = null;
        void Add(string name, string value, int offset, int length) => fields?.Add(new(name, value, new(offset, length)));
        if (adu.Length < 2) { error = $"Truncated MBAP header: {adu.Length} of 7 bytes"; return; }
        ushort tx = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(adu);
        Add("Transaction ID", Word(tx), 0, 2);
        if (adu.Length < 4) { error = $"Truncated MBAP header: {adu.Length} of 7 bytes"; return; }
        ushort protocol = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(adu[2..]);
        Add("Protocol ID", Word(protocol) + (protocol == 0 ? " · Modbus" : " · not Modbus"), 2, 2);
        if (protocol != 0) { error = $"Protocol ID {protocol} is not 0 (Modbus)"; return; }
        if (adu.Length < 6) { error = $"Truncated MBAP header: {adu.Length} of 7 bytes"; return; }
        ushort length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(adu[4..]);
        Add("Length", $"{length} bytes follow", 4, 2);
        if (length is < 2 or > 254) { error = $"Length {length} is outside 2–254"; return; }
        if (adu.Length - 6 < length) { error = $"Truncated frame: length says {length} bytes follow but {adu.Length - 6} are present"; return; }
        if (adu.Length - 6 > length) { error = $"Frame has {adu.Length - 6 - length} byte(s) beyond the declared length"; return; }
        byte unit = adu[6];
        Add("Unit ID", unit.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), 6, 1);
        var header = new Mbap(tx, protocol, length, unit);
        byte fc = adu[7];
        var data = adu[8..];
        if ((fc & 0x80) != 0)
        {
            int baseFc = fc & 0x7F;
            Add("Function code", $"{fc:X2} · Exception for {baseFc:X2}", 7, 1);
            if (direction == FrameDirection.Request) { error = "An exception function code is not valid in a request"; return; }
            if (baseFc == 0) { error = "Function code 0 is not valid"; return; }
            if (data.Length != 1) { error = $"Exception response must have 1 exception code byte, found {data.Length}"; return; }
            Add("Exception code", $"{data[0]:X2} · {ExceptionName(data[0])}", 8, 1);
            parsed = new(header, fc, null, null, null, Array.Empty<ushort>(), data[0]);
            error = null; return;
        }
        if (fc is 3 or 4)
        {
            Add("Function code", $"{fc:D2} · {FunctionName(fc)}", 7, 1);
            if (direction == FrameDirection.Request)
            {
                if (data.Length != 4) { error = $"FC{fc:D2} request must have 4 data bytes, found {data.Length}"; return; }
                ushort address = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data), quantity = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data[2..]);
                Add("Start address", Word(address) + " · zero-based offset", 8, 2);
                Add("Quantity", $"{quantity} register(s)", 10, 2);
                if (quantity is < 1 or > 125) { error = $"Quantity {quantity} is outside 1–125"; return; }
                if (address + quantity > 65536) { error = "Start address plus quantity exceeds 65536"; return; }
                parsed = new(header, fc, address, quantity, null, Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
                error = null; return;
            }
            if (data.Length < 1) { error = "Truncated response: byte count missing"; return; }
            byte count = data[0];
            Add("Byte count", count.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), 8, 1);
            if (count != data.Length - 1) { error = $"Byte count {count} does not match the {data.Length - 1} data bytes present"; return; }
            if (count % 2 != 0 || count is < 2 or > 250) { error = $"Byte count {count} must be even and 2–250"; return; }
            var registers = new ushort[count / 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < registers.Length; i++)
            {
                registers[i] = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data[(1 + 2 * i)..]);
                string name = requestAddress.HasValue ? $"Register {requestAddress.Value + i}" : $"Register {i + 1}";
                Add(name, Word(registers[i]), 9 + 2 * i, 2);
            }
            parsed = new(header, fc, null, null, count, registers, null);
            error = null; return;
        }
        if (fc == 6)
        {
            Add("Function code", $"06 · {FunctionName(6)}", 7, 1);
            if (data.Length != 4) { error = $"FC06 must have 4 data bytes, found {data.Length}"; return; }
            ushort address = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data), value = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data[2..]);
            Add("Register address", Word(address) + " · zero-based offset", 8, 2);
            Add("Register value", Word(value), 10, 2);
            parsed = new(header, fc, address, value, null, Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            error = null; return;
        }
        Add("Function code", $"{fc:X2} · {FunctionName(fc)}", 7, 1);
        error = $"Function code {fc:X2} is not supported in this simulation";
    }
}

// ClientStop is set when the client deliberately stopped reading, so Received holds only the bytes read so far.
public sealed record ModbusExchange(byte[]? Sent, byte[]? Received, string? ClientStop = null);
public sealed record ModbusResult(string Status, ushort[] Values, int? ExceptionCode, ModbusExchange Exchange);

public static class ModbusClient
{
    // Learner read path: FC03/FC04 only. Any other function is refused before a socket is opened.
    public static async Task<ModbusResult> ReadAsync(int port, int unit, int function, int address, int quantity, CancellationToken=<redacted>    {
        if (function is not (3 or 4)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(function), "ModbusClient sends only FC03 and FC04 reads");
        var request = ModbusCodec.EncodeReadRequest(1, (byte)unit, (byte)function, (ushort)address, (ushort)quantity);
        byte[]? sent = null, received = null;
        string? clientStop = null;
        ModbusResult Result(string status, ushort[] values, int? code) => new(status, values, code, new(sent, received, clientStop));
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300));
        try
        {
            using var client = new TcpClient();
            await client.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, port, deadline.Token);
            using var stream = client.GetStream();
            await stream.WriteAsync(request, deadline.Token);
            sent = request;
            var header = new byte[7];
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, deadline.Token);
            received = header;
            int length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
            var mismatches = new List<string>();
            if (BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header) != 1) mismatches.Add("transaction ID");
            if (BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(2)) != 0) mismatches.Add("protocol ID");
            if (header[6] != unit) mismatches.Add("unit ID");
            if (length < 2 || length > 254) mismatches.Add("length");
            if (mismatches.Count > 0)
            {
                clientStop = $"Client stopped after header: {string.Join(", ", mismatches)} mismatch. Only the 7 header bytes received were kept.";
                return Result("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            }
            var pdu = new byte[length - 1];
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(pdu, deadline.Token);
            received = header.Concat(pdu).ToArray();
            if (pdu.Length == 2 && pdu[0] == (function | 0x80)) return Result("exception", Array.Empty<ushort>(), pdu[1]);
            if (pdu.Length != 2 + quantity * 2 || pdu[0] != function || pdu[1] != quantity * 2) return Result("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            var values = new ushort[quantity];
            for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++) values[i] = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(2 + 2 * i));
            return Result("response", values, null);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { received = null; return Result("timeout", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException) { return Result("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null); }
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using GhostWire;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders;

var app = GhostWireHost.Create(args);
await app.RunAsync();

namespace GhostWire
{
    public static class GhostWireHost
    {
        public static WebApplication Create(string[] args, int? port = null)
        {
            int selectedPort = port ?? PortFromEnvironment();
            var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(new WebApplicationOptions { Args = args, ContentRootPath = AppContext.BaseDirectory });
            builder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(options =>
            {
                options.Listen(IPAddress.Loopback, selectedPort);
                options.Limits.MaxRequestBodySize = 16384;
                options.Limits.MaxConcurrentConnections = 64;
                options.Limits.RequestHeadersTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
            });
            builder.Services.AddSingleton<TrainingService>();
            builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
            {
                options.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
                options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(context =>
                    RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter("local", _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                    {
                        PermitLimit = 120, Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), QueueLimit = 0, AutoReplenishment = true
                    }));
            });
            var app = builder.Build();
            // Resolve eagerly so a Phantom Writer generation failure stops startup instead of failing the first request.
            app.Services.GetRequiredService<TrainingService>();
            var concurrentTests = new SemaphoreSlim(8);
            app.Use(async (context, next) =>
            {
                var host = context.Request.Host;
                bool validHost = (string.Equals(host.Host, "localhost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || host.Host == "127.0.0.1") && host.Port == context.Connection.LocalPort;
                bool local = context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress != null && IPAddress.IsLoopback(context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
                if (!validHost || !local)
                {
                    context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                    await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "Forbidden host" });
                    return;
                }
                if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("Origin", out var origins))
                {
                    string expected = $"http://{host.Host}:{host.Port}";
                    if (origins.Count != 1 || !string.Equals(origins[0], expected, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "Cross-origin requests are not allowed" });
                        return;
                    }
                }
                context.Response.Headers.XContentTypeOptions = "nosniff";
                if (context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/api")) context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
                await next();
            });
            app.UseRateLimiter();
            app.MapGet("/api/scenarios", (TrainingService service) => Results.Json(service.Scenarios()));
            // Shared by POST /api/test and POST /api/incident/answer: content type, 16 KiB body, JSON parsing and the 8-slot gate.
            async Task<IResult> ReadJsonBodyAsync(HttpContext context, Func<JsonElement, Task<IResult>> handle)
            {
                if (!System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue.TryParse(context.Request.ContentType, out var type) || !string.Equals(type.MediaType, "application/json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return Results.Json(new { error = "Content-Type must be application/json" }, statusCode: 415);
                if (context.Request.ContentLength is 0 or > 16384) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                if (!await concurrentTests.WaitAsync(0, context.RequestAborted)) return Results.Json(new { error = "Too many concurrent tests" }, statusCode: 429);
                try
                {
                    using var buffer = new MemoryStream();
                    var bytes = new byte[4096];
                    while (true)
                    {
                        int count = await context.Request.Body.ReadAsync(bytes, context.RequestAborted);
                        if (count == 0) break;
                        if (buffer.Length + count > 16384) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                        buffer.Write(bytes, 0, count);
                    }
                    if (buffer.Length == 0) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                    using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(buffer.ToArray());
                    return await handle(document.RootElement);
                }
                catch (JsonException) { return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid JSON" }, statusCode: 400); }
                catch (ArgumentException ex) { return Results.Json(new { error = ex.Message }, statusCode: 400); }
                finally { concurrentTests.Release(); }
            }
            app.MapPost("/api/test", (HttpContext context, TrainingService service) => ReadJsonBodyAsync(context, async payload =>
            {
                var request = TrainingService.Validate(payload);
                return Results.Json(await service.TestAsync(request, context.RequestAborted));
            }));
            app.MapGet("/api/incident/{scenario_id}/log", (string scenario_id, TrainingService service) =>
                service.IncidentLog(scenario_id) is { } log ? Results.Json(log) : Results.Json(new { error = "Not found" }, statusCode: 404));
            app.MapPost("/api/incident/answer", (HttpContext context, TrainingService service) => ReadJsonBodyAsync(context, async payload =>
            {
                var answer = TrainingService.ValidateAnswer(payload);
                return Results.Json(await service.AnswerAsync(answer, context.RequestAborted));
            }));
            app.Map("/api/{**path}", () => Results.Json(new { error = "Not found" }, statusCode: 404));
            var frontend = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "frontend");
            if (!Directory.Exists(frontend)) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Frontend assets not found: {frontend}");
            var files = new PhysicalFileProvider(frontend);
            app.UseDefaultFiles(new DefaultFilesOptions { FileProvider = files });
            app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions { FileProvider = files });
            return app;
        }

        private static int PortFromEnvironment()
        {
            var value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_PORT");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return 8000;
            if (!int.TryParse(value, out int port) || port is < 1 or > 65535) throw new ArgumentException("GHOSTWIRE_PORT must be between 1 and 65535.");
            return port;
        }
    }
}

<content>
'use strict';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const fields = ['unit_id', 'function_code', 'address', 'quantity', 'scale'];
const categories = [
  ['observations', 'Observations'],
  ['possible_causes', 'Possible causes'],
  ['training_hints', 'Training hints'],
  ['next_steps', 'Next steps'],
];
let scenarios = [];
let history = [];
const caseHistory = new Map();
let running = false;

function text(value, fallback = 'Not returned') {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return fallback;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? value.map((item) => text(item)).join(', ') : fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  return String(value);
}
function engineeringValue(result) {
  const value = result.engineering_value;
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'Not returned';
  return `${text(value)}${result.unit ? ` ${text(result.unit)}` : ''}`;
}

function validateScale() {
  const input = $('scale');
  input.setCustomValidity(input.value !== '' && Number(input.value) <= 0 ? 'Scale must be greater than zero.' : '');
}

// Client-side bounds mirror the server whitelist for POST /api/test. The server still validates every field.
const fieldRules = {
  unit_id: [1, 247, true, 'Unit ID must be a whole number from 1 to 247.'],
  address: [0, 65535, true, 'Address must be a whole number from 0 to 65535.'],
  quantity: [1, 125, true, 'Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 125.'],
  scale: [0, 1000000, false, 'Scale must be a number greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000.'],
};

function requestProblem() {
  for (const [field, [min, max, integer, message]] of Object.entries(fieldRules)) {
    const raw = $(field).value.trim();
    const value = Number(raw);
    const ok = raw !== '' && Number.isFinite(value) && value <= max && (integer ? Number.isInteger(value) && value >= min : value > min);
    if (!ok) return { field, message };
  }
  if (Number($('address').value) + Number($('quantity').value) > 65536) {
    return { field: 'quantity', message: 'Address plus quantity must not go past register 65535.' };
  }
  return null;
}

function setInvalid(field, invalid) {
  const input = $(field);
  const described = (input.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(' ').filter((id) => id && id !== 'test-message');
  if (invalid) {
    input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    described.push('test-message');
  } else {
    input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
  }
  if (described.length) input.setAttribute('aria-describedby', described.join(' '));
  else input.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
}

function clearInvalid() {
  for (const field of Object.keys(fieldRules)) setInvalid(field, false);
}

function verifiedText(value) {
  if (value === true) return 'Verified by this simulated test.';
  if (value === false) return 'Not verified by this simulated test.';
  return text(value, 'No verification result returned.');
}

function sourceText(value) {
  if (value === 'openai-compatible') return 'Source: AI provider';
  if (value === 'deterministic') return 'Source: deterministic fallback';
  return `Source: ${text(value, 'not specified')}`;
}

function fillList(element, values) {
  element.replaceChildren();
  const items = Array.isArray(values) ? values : (values == null ? [] : [values]);
  for (const item of items.length ? items : ['None returned.']) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.textContent = text(item);
    element.append(li);
  }
}

function addText(parent, tag, value, className) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  node.textContent = value;
  if (className) node.className = className;
  parent.append(node);
  return node;
}

function renderDocumentation(documentation) {
  const container = $('documentation');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const entries = Array.isArray(documentation) ? documentation : [documentation];
  for (const entry of entries) addText(container, 'p', text(entry, 'No documentation returned.'));
}

function selectScenario() {
  const scenario = scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value);
  if (!scenario) return;
  $('scenario-summary').textContent = text(scenario.summary, '');
  renderDocumentation(scenario.documentation);
  $('history-scenario').textContent = `Scenario: ${text(scenario.title)}`;
  history = caseHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  const latest = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const field of fields) $(field).value = latest?.request?.[field] ?? scenario.initial[field];
  validateScale();
  clearInvalid();
  if (latest) {
    renderResult(latest);
  } else {
    $('result').hidden = true;
    $('empty-result').hidden = false;
    $('result-status').textContent = 'Awaiting read';
    $('result-status').dataset.state = '';
  }
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('test-message').textContent = '';
  $('run-test').textContent = latest ? 'Retest simulated read' : 'Run simulated read';
  renderHistory();
  const security = scenario.category === 'security';
  $('incident-panel').hidden = !security;
  if (security) showIncident(scenario);
}

async function api(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(path, options);
  let data;
  try { data = await response.json(); } catch { throw new Error(`Server returned an unreadable response (HTTP ${response.status}).`); }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data.detail || data.error || data.message;
    throw new Error(detail ? text(detail) : `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
  }
  return data;
}

let frameIds = 0;
// Renders frames returned by the server. Every byte and value comes from the response; textContent only.
function renderFrames(container, frames, label) {
  container.replaceChildren();
  if (!Array.isArray(frames) || !frames.length) {
    addText(container, 'p', 'No frame was returned: the request bytes did not reach the simulator.', 'muted');
    return;
  }
  for (const frame of frames) {
    const id = `frame-${label}-${++frameIds}`;
    const block = document.createElement('section');
    block.className = 'frame';
    block.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `${id}-title`);
    const heading = addText(block, 'h4', frame.direction === 'request' ? 'Request sent to simulator' : 'Response from simulator');
    heading.id = `${id}-title`;
    const hex = document.createElement('code');
    hex.className = 'hex';
    hex.setAttribute('aria-label', `${heading.textContent}, hexadecimal bytes`);
    const bytes = text(frame.hex, '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    bytes.forEach((byte, index) => {
      if (index) hex.append(' ');
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.dataset.i = String(index);
      span.textContent = byte;
      hex.append(span);
    });
    block.append(hex);
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.className = 'frame-table';
    const caption = addText(table, 'caption', `${heading.textContent}: decoded fields (simulated)`);
    caption.className = 'visually-hidden';
    const head = document.createElement('thead');
    const headRow = document.createElement('tr');
    for (const name of ['Field', 'Bytes (hex)', 'Decoded value']) {
      const th = addText(headRow, 'th', name);
      th.scope = 'col';
    }
    head.append(headRow);
    table.append(head);
    const body = document.createElement('tbody');
    const spans = Array.from(hex.querySelectorAll('span'));
    (Array.isArray(frame.fields) ? frame.fields : []).forEach((field, index) => {
      const offset = Number(field?.bytes?.offset);
      const length = Number(field?.bytes?.length);
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      row.tabIndex = 0;
      const nameCell = addText(row, 'th', text(field.name));
      nameCell.scope = 'row';
      const bytesCell = document.createElement('td');
      addText(bytesCell, 'code', bytes.slice(offset, offset + length).join(' '));
      const range = addText(bytesCell, 'span', length > 1 ? ` bytes ${offset}–${offset + length - 1}` : ` byte ${offset}`, 'range');
      range.id = `${id}-range-${index}`;
      row.setAttribute('aria-describedby', range.id);
      row.append(bytesCell);
      addText(row, 'td', text(field.value));
      const highlight = (on) => {
        spans.forEach((span, i) => span.classList.toggle('hl', on && i >= offset && i < offset + length));
        row.classList.toggle('active', on);
      };
      row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => highlight(true));
      row.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => highlight(false));
      row.addEventListener('focusin', () => highlight(true));
      row.addEventListener('focusout', () => highlight(false));
      body.append(row);
    });
    if (frame.decode_error) {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      row.className = 'decode-error';
      const cell = addText(row, 'td', `Decode error: ${text(frame.decode_error)}`);
      cell.colSpan = 3;
      body.append(row);
    }
    table.append(body);
    block.append(table);
    container.append(block);
  }
}

  addText(container, 'p', changed.length

function renderHistory() {

let expandedBeforePrint = [];

// ---- Security incident: simulated traffic log and answer ----
const incidentLogs = new Map();
const answerHistory = new Map();
const verifiedTransaction = new Map();
let answering = false;

function currentScenario() { return scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value); }

async function showIncident(scenario) {
  $('answer-result').hidden = true;
  const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  if (attempts.length) renderAnswer(attempts[attempts.length - 1]);
  renderAnswerHints(scenario.id);
  if (incidentLogs.has(scenario.id)) { renderLog(scenario.id); return; }
  $('log-body').replaceChildren();
  $('log-note').textContent = 'Loading the simulated capture…';
  try {
    const log = await api(`/api/incident/${encodeURIComponent(scenario.id)}/log`);
    incidentLogs.set(scenario.id, log);
    if (currentScenario()?.id === scenario.id) renderLog(scenario.id);
  } catch (error) {
    $('log-note').textContent = `Could not load the simulated traffic log: ${error.message}`;
  }
}

function renderLog(scenarioId) {
  const log = incidentLogs.get(scenarioId);
  const body = $('log-body');
  body.replaceChildren();
  $('log-note').textContent = `Simulated capture. ${text(log.capture_note, '')}`;
  const flagged = verifiedTransaction.get(scenarioId);
  for (const entry of Array.isArray(log.entries) ? log.entries : []) {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    const seq = addText(row, 'td', text(entry.sequence));
    if (flagged !== undefined && entry.transaction_id === flagged) {
      row.dataset.flag = 'unauthorized';
      row.tabIndex = 0;
      row.setAttribute('aria-label', `Sequence ${text(entry.sequence)}: unauthorized write, verified by your answer`);
      seq.append(document.createElement('br'));
      addText(seq, 'strong', '⚠ Unauthorized write', 'flag');
    }
    const timeCell = document.createElement('td');
    const iso = text(entry.time);
    const clock = /T(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})/.exec(iso);
    if (clock) {
      // Short visible time; the full ISO timestamp is in the title and read by screen readers.
      const time = addText(timeCell, 'time', clock[1]);
      time.dateTime = iso;
      time.title = iso;
      time.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      addText(timeCell, 'span', iso, 'visually-hidden');
    } else {
      timeCell.textContent = iso;
    }
    row.append(timeCell);
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.client));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.transaction_id));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.unit_id));
    addText(row, 'td', `${String(entry.function_code).padStart(2, '0')} · ${text(entry.function_name)}`, 'wrap');
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.address));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.values));
    // Frames open in a full-width row below the entry instead of inside a narrow cell.
    const framesRow = document.createElement('tr');
    framesRow.className = 'frames-row';
    framesRow.id = `log-frames-${text(entry.sequence)}`;
    framesRow.hidden = true;
    const framesCell = document.createElement('td');
    framesCell.colSpan = 9;
    framesRow.append(framesCell);
    const toggleCell = document.createElement('td');
    const toggle = document.createElement('button');
    toggle.type = 'button';
    toggle.className = 'secondary';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls', framesRow.id);
    const setToggleLabel = (open) => {
      toggle.replaceChildren(open ? 'Hide frames' : 'Show frames');
      addText(toggle, 'span', ` for transaction ${text(entry.transaction_id)}`, 'visually-hidden');
    };
    setToggleLabel(false);
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = framesRow.hidden;
      if (open && !framesCell.childElementCount) {
        addText(framesCell, 'p', `Frames for transaction ${text(entry.transaction_id)} (simulated capture)`, 'frames-title');
        const frames = document.createElement('div');
        framesCell.append(frames);
        renderFrames(frames, entry.frames, `log-${entry.sequence}`);
      }
      framesRow.hidden = !open;
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      setToggleLabel(open);
    });
    toggleCell.append(toggle);
    row.append(toggleCell);
    body.append(row, framesRow);
  }
}

// Progressive training hints, kept client-side: none for the first 2 unverified answers,
// hint 1 from the 3rd, hint 2 from the 4th. Hidden once an answer is verified. They never name the row.
const answerHints = [
  'Look at the Function column: which entry changes data instead of reading it?',
  'Compare the value read before and after each entry.',
];
const hintThreshold = 3;

function renderAnswerHints(scenarioId) {
  const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenarioId) || [];
  const wrong = attempts.filter((entry) => entry.verified !== true).length;
  const shown = attempts.some((entry) => entry.verified === true) ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(answerHints.length, wrong - hintThreshold + 1));
  const list = $('answer-hint-list');
  list.replaceChildren();
  answerHints.slice(0, shown).forEach((hint, index) => addText(list, 'li', `Training hint ${index + 1}: ${hint}`));
  $('answer-hints').hidden = shown === 0;
  return shown;
}

function renderAnswer(result) {
  $('answer-result').hidden = false;
  const ok = result.verified === true;
  $('answer-status').textContent = ok ? 'Status: answer verified' : 'Status: answer not verified';
  $('answer-status').dataset.state = ok ? 'success' : 'error';
  for (const key of ['observations', 'possible_causes', 'training_hints', 'next_steps']) fillList($(`answer-${key}`), result[key]);
  const mitigations = Array.isArray(result.mitigations) ? result.mitigations : [];
  $('mitigations-section').hidden = mitigations.length === 0;
  fillList($('answer-mitigations'), mitigations);
  $('answer-verified').textContent = ok ? 'Verified by the simulated capture: this transaction ID and client label match the write.' : 'Not verified by the simulated capture.';
  $('answer-verified').parentElement.dataset.state = ok ? 'success' : '';
  $('answer-explanation').textContent = text(result.explanation, 'No explanation returned.');
  $('answer-explanation-source').textContent = sourceText(result.explanation_source);
}

function renderAnswerHistory() {
  const list = $('answer-history');
  list.replaceChildren();
  const scenario = currentScenario();
  const attempts = scenario ? (answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || []) : [];
  $('answer-history-title').hidden = attempts.length === 0;
  attempts.forEach((entry, index) => {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    addText(details, 'summary', `Answer ${index + 1} · transaction ${text(entry.answer?.transaction_id)} · client ${text(entry.answer?.client)} · ${entry.verified === true ? 'Verified by the simulated capture.' : 'Not verified by the simulated capture.'}`);
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'history-detail';
    for (const [key, label] of [...categories, ['mitigations', 'Next steps · real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation']]) {
      if (key === 'mitigations' && !(entry.mitigations || []).length) continue;
      addText(body, 'h3', label);
      const ul = document.createElement('ul');
      fillList(ul, entry[key]);
      body.append(ul);
    }
    addText(body, 'h3', `Explanation · ${sourceText(entry.explanation_source)}`);
    addText(body, 'p', text(entry.explanation, 'No explanation returned.'));
    details.append(body);
    item.append(details);
    list.append(item);
  });
  if (attempts.length) {
    $('print-report').disabled = false;
    $('history-empty').hidden = true;
  }
}

$('answer-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (answering) return;
  if (!$('answer-form').reportValidity()) return;
  const scenario = currentScenario();
  if (!scenario || scenario.category !== 'security') return;
  const request = { scenario_id: scenario.id, transaction_id: Number($('answer-transaction').value), client: $('answer-client').value.trim() };
  answering = true;

  $('submit-answer').setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');

  try {
    const result = await api('/api/incident/answer', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(request) });
    if (!result.answer) result.answer = request;
    const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
    const hintsBefore = renderAnswerHints(scenario.id);
    attempts.push(result);
    answerHistory.set(scenario.id, attempts);

    renderAnswer(result);
    if (incidentLogs.has(scenario.id)) renderLog(scenario.id);
    renderAnswerHistory();
    const hintsAfter = renderAnswerHints(scenario.id);
    $('test-message').textContent = result.verified === true
      ? 'Answer verified by the simulated capture. The matching log row is now marked "Unauthorized write".'
      : `Answer not verified by the simulated capture. Review the log and try again.${hintsAfter > hintsBefore ? ` Training hint ${hintsAfter}: ${answerHints[hintsAfter - 1]}` : ''}`;
  } catch (error) {
    $('test-message').textContent = `Answer failed: ${error.message}`;
    $('test-message').dataset.state = 'error';
  } finally {
    answering = false;
    $('answer-fields').disabled = false;
    $('submit-answer').removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
  }
});

$('scenario').addEventListener('change', selectScenario);
$('scale').addEventListener('input', validateScale);
for (const field of Object.keys(fieldRules)) $(field).addEventListener('input', () => setInvalid(field, false));

// Guided tour banner for first-time visitors. Dismissal is remembered in localStorage when available.

'use strict';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const fields = ['unit_id', 'function_code', 'address', 'quantity', 'scale'];
const categories = [
  ['observations', 'Observations'],
  ['possible_causes', 'Possible causes'],
  ['training_hints', 'Training hints'],
  ['next_steps', 'Next steps'],
];
let scenarios = [];
let history = [];
const caseHistory = new Map();
let running = false;

function text(value, fallback = 'Not returned') {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return fallback;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? value.map((item) => text(item)).join(', ') : fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  return String(value);
}
function engineeringValue(result) {
  const value = result.engineering_value;
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'Not returned';
  return `${text(value)}${result.unit ? ` ${text(result.unit)}` : ''}`;
}

function validateScale() {
  const input = $('scale');
  input.setCustomValidity(input.value !== '' && Number(input.value) <= 0 ? 'Scale must be greater than zero.' : '');
}

// Client-side bounds mirror the server whitelist for POST /api/test. The server still validates every field.
const fieldRules = {
  unit_id: [1, 247, true, 'Unit ID must be a whole number from 1 to 247.'],
  address: [0, 65535, true, 'Address must be a whole number from 0 to 65535.'],
  quantity: [1, 125, true, 'Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 125.'],
  scale: [0, 1000000, false, 'Scale must be a number greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000.'],
};

function requestProblem() {
  for (const [field, [min, max, integer, message]] of Object.entries(fieldRules)) {
    const raw = $(field).value.trim();
    const value = Number(raw);
    const ok = raw !== '' && Number.isFinite(value) && value <= max && (integer ? Number.isInteger(value) && value >= min : value > min);
    if (!ok) return { field, message };
  }
  if (Number($('address').value) + Number($('quantity').value) > 65536) {
    return { field: 'quantity', message: 'Address plus quantity must not go past register 65535.' };
  }
  return null;
}

function setInvalid(field, invalid) {
  const input = $(field);
  const described = (input.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(' ').filter((id) => id && id !== 'test-message');
  if (invalid) {
    input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    described.push('test-message');
  } else {
    input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
  }
  if (described.length) input.setAttribute('aria-describedby', described.join(' '));
  else input.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
}

function clearInvalid() {
  for (const field of Object.keys(fieldRules)) setInvalid(field, false);
}

function verifiedText(value) {
  if (value === true) return 'Verified by this simulated test.';
  if (value === false) return 'Not verified by this simulated test.';
  return text(value, 'No verification result returned.');
}

function sourceText(value) {
  if (value === 'openai-compatible') return 'Source: AI provider';
  if (value === 'deterministic') return 'Source: deterministic fallback';
  return `Source: ${text(value, 'not specified')}`;
}

function fillList(element, values) {
  element.replaceChildren();
  const items = Array.isArray(values) ? values : (values == null ? [] : [values]);
  for (const item of items.length ? items : ['None returned.']) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.textContent = text(item);
    element.append(li);
  }
}

function addText(parent, tag, value, className) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  node.textContent = value;
  if (className) node.className = className;
  parent.append(node);
  return node;
}

function renderDocumentation(documentation) {
  const container = $('documentation');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const entries = Array.isArray(documentation) ? documentation : [documentation];
  for (const entry of entries) addText(container, 'p', text(entry, 'No documentation returned.'));
}

function selectScenario() {
  const scenario = scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value);
  if (!scenario) return;
  $('scenario-summary').textContent = text(scenario.summary, '');
  renderDocumentation(scenario.documentation);
  $('history-scenario').textContent = `Scenario: ${text(scenario.title)}`;
  history = caseHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  const latest = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const field of fields) $(field).value = latest?.request?.[field] ?? scenario.initial[field];
  validateScale();
  clearInvalid();
  if (latest) {
    renderResult(latest);
  } else {
    $('result').hidden = true;
    $('empty-result').hidden = false;
    $('result-status').textContent = 'Awaiting read';
    $('result-status').dataset.state = '';
  }
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('test-message').textContent = '';
  $('run-test').textContent = latest ? 'Retest simulated read' : 'Run simulated read';
  renderHistory();
  const security = scenario.category === 'security';
  $('incident-panel').hidden = !security;
  if (security) showIncident(scenario);
}

async function api(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(path, options);
  let data;
  try { data = await response.json(); } catch { throw new Error(`Server returned an unreadable response (HTTP ${response.status}).`); }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data.detail || data.error || data.message;
    throw new Error(detail ? text(detail) : `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function loadScenarios() {
  $('load-message').hidden = false;
  $('load-message').textContent = 'Loading scenarios…';
  $('load-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('retry-load').hidden = true;
  $('setup-content').hidden = true;
  try {
    const data = await api('/api/scenarios');
    if (!Array.isArray(data.scenarios) || !data.scenarios.length) throw new Error('No scenarios were returned.');
    scenarios = data.scenarios;
    $('scenario').replaceChildren();
    const groups = [['troubleshooting', 'Troubleshooting'], ['security', 'Security incidents']];
    for (const [category, label] of groups) {
      const members = scenarios.filter((scenario) => scenario.category === category);
      if (!members.length) continue;
      const group = document.createElement('optgroup');
      group.label = label;
      for (const scenario of members) {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = scenario.id;
        option.textContent = scenario.difficulty ? `${text(scenario.title)} · ${text(scenario.difficulty)}` : text(scenario.title);
        group.append(option);
      }
      $('scenario').append(group);
    }
    for (const scenario of scenarios.filter((item) => !groups.some(([category]) => category === item.category))) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = scenario.id;
      option.textContent = text(scenario.title);
      $('scenario').append(option);
    }
    selectScenario();
    $('setup-content').hidden = false;
    $('load-message').hidden = true;
    showTour();
  } catch (error) {
    $('load-message').textContent = `Could not load scenarios: ${error.message}`;
    $('load-message').dataset.state = 'error';
    $('retry-load').hidden = false;
  }
}

function renderResult(result) {
  $('empty-result').hidden = true;
  $('result').hidden = false;
  $('result-status').textContent = `Status: ${text(result.status, 'unknown')}`;
  $('result-status').dataset.state = result.status === 'response' ? 'success' : (result.status === 'exception' || result.status === 'error' ? 'error' : '');
  $('engineering-value').textContent = engineeringValue(result);
  $('raw-registers').textContent = text(result.raw_registers);
  for (const [key] of categories) fillList($(key), result[key]);
  $('verified').textContent = verifiedText(result.verified);
  $('verified').parentElement.dataset.state = result.verified === true ? 'success' : '';
  $('explanation').textContent = text(result.explanation, 'No explanation returned.');
  $('explanation-source').textContent = sourceText(result.explanation_source);
  renderFrames($('frames'), result.frames, 'read');
}

let frameIds = 0;
// Renders frames returned by the server. Every byte and value comes from the response; textContent only.
function renderFrames(container, frames, label) {
  container.replaceChildren();
  if (!Array.isArray(frames) || !frames.length) {
    addText(container, 'p', 'No frame was returned: the request bytes did not reach the simulator.', 'muted');
    return;
  }
  for (const frame of frames) {
    const id = `frame-${label}-${++frameIds}`;
    const block = document.createElement('section');
    block.className = 'frame';
    block.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `${id}-title`);
    const heading = addText(block, 'h4', frame.direction === 'request' ? 'Request sent to simulator' : 'Response from simulator');
    heading.id = `${id}-title`;
    const hex = document.createElement('code');
    hex.className = 'hex';
    hex.setAttribute('aria-label', `${heading.textContent}, hexadecimal bytes`);
    const bytes = text(frame.hex, '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    bytes.forEach((byte, index) => {
      if (index) hex.append(' ');
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.dataset.i = String(index);
      span.textContent = byte;
      hex.append(span);
    });
    block.append(hex);
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.className = 'frame-table';
    const caption = addText(table, 'caption', `${heading.textContent}: decoded fields (simulated)`);
    caption.className = 'visually-hidden';
    const head = document.createElement('thead');
    const headRow = document.createElement('tr');
    for (const name of ['Field', 'Bytes (hex)', 'Decoded value']) {
      const th = addText(headRow, 'th', name);
      th.scope = 'col';
    }
    head.append(headRow);
    table.append(head);
    const body = document.createElement('tbody');
    const spans = Array.from(hex.querySelectorAll('span'));
    (Array.isArray(frame.fields) ? frame.fields : []).forEach((field, index) => {
      const offset = Number(field?.bytes?.offset);
      const length = Number(field?.bytes?.length);
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      row.tabIndex = 0;
      const nameCell = addText(row, 'th', text(field.name));
      nameCell.scope = 'row';
      const bytesCell = document.createElement('td');
      addText(bytesCell, 'code', bytes.slice(offset, offset + length).join(' '));
      const range = addText(bytesCell, 'span', length > 1 ? ` bytes ${offset}–${offset + length - 1}` : ` byte ${offset}`, 'range');
      range.id = `${id}-range-${index}`;
      row.setAttribute('aria-describedby', range.id);
      row.append(bytesCell);
      addText(row, 'td', text(field.value));
      const highlight = (on) => {
        spans.forEach((span, i) => span.classList.toggle('hl', on && i >= offset && i < offset + length));
        row.classList.toggle('active', on);
      };
      row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => highlight(true));
      row.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => highlight(false));
      row.addEventListener('focusin', () => highlight(true));
      row.addEventListener('focusout', () => highlight(false));
      body.append(row);
    });
    if (frame.decode_error) {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      row.className = 'decode-error';
      const cell = addText(row, 'td', `Decode error: ${text(frame.decode_error)}`);
      cell.colSpan = 3;
      body.append(row);
    }
    table.append(body);
    block.append(table);
    container.append(block);
  }
}
function renderComparison() {
  const container = $('comparison-results');
  container.replaceChildren();
  const hasComparison = history.length >= 2;
  $('comparison-empty').hidden = hasComparison;
  container.hidden = !hasComparison;
  if (!hasComparison) return;

  const previous = history[history.length - 2];
  const current = history[history.length - 1];
  for (const [label, entry, number] of [
    ['Previous', previous, history.length - 1],
    ['Current', current, history.length],
  ]) {
    const section = document.createElement('section');
    section.className = 'comparison-read';
    addText(section, 'h3', `${label} · read ${number}`);
    const request = entry.request || {};
    addText(section, 'p', `Request: unit ${text(request.unit_id)}, function ${text(request.function_code)}, address ${text(request.address)}, quantity ${text(request.quantity)}, scale ${text(request.scale)}.`);
    addText(section, 'p', `Status: ${text(entry.status, 'unknown')}. Raw registers: ${text(entry.raw_registers)}. Engineering value: ${engineeringValue(entry)} (simulated).`);
    addText(section, 'p', verifiedText(entry.verified));
    container.append(section);
  }
  const changed = fields.filter((field) => previous.request?.[field] !== current.request?.[field]);
  const labels = { unit_id: 'Unit ID', function_code: 'Function code', address: 'Address', quantity: 'Quantity', scale: 'Scale' };
  addText(container, 'p', changed.length
    ? `Changed settings: ${changed.map((field) => `${labels[field]} (${text(previous.request?.[field])} to ${text(current.request?.[field])})`).join(', ')}.`
    : 'No request settings changed between these reads.', 'comparison-changes');
}


function renderHistory() {
  const list = $('history-list');
  list.replaceChildren();
  $('history-empty').hidden = history.length > 0;
  $('print-report').disabled = history.length === 0;
  renderComparison();
  history.forEach((entry, index) => {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = `Read ${index + 1} · ${text(entry.status, 'unknown')} · ${verifiedText(entry.verified)}`;
    details.append(summary);
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'history-detail';
    const request = entry.request || {};
    addText(body, 'p', `Request: unit ${text(request.unit_id)}, function ${text(request.function_code)}, address ${text(request.address)}, quantity ${text(request.quantity)}, scale ${text(request.scale)}.`);
    addText(body, 'p', `Raw registers: ${text(entry.raw_registers)}. Engineering value: ${engineeringValue(entry)} (simulated).`);
    for (const frame of Array.isArray(entry.frames) ? entry.frames : []) {
      addText(body, 'p', `${frame.direction === 'request' ? 'Request frame' : 'Response frame'} (simulated, hex): ${text(frame.hex)}${frame.decode_error ? ` · Decode error: ${text(frame.decode_error)}` : ''}`, 'hex-line');
    }
    for (const [key, label] of categories) {
      addText(body, 'h3', label);
      const ul = document.createElement('ul');
      fillList(ul, entry[key]);
      body.append(ul);
    }
    addText(body, 'h3', `Explanation · ${sourceText(entry.explanation_source)}`);
    addText(body, 'p', text(entry.explanation, 'No explanation returned.'));
    details.append(body);
    item.append(details);
    list.append(item);
  });
  renderAnswerHistory();
}

let expandedBeforePrint = [];
const historyDetails = () => [...$('history-list').querySelectorAll('details'), ...$('answer-history').querySelectorAll('details')];
window.addEventListener('beforeprint', () => {
  expandedBeforePrint = historyDetails().map((details) => details.open);
  historyDetails().forEach((details) => { details.open = true; });
});
window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
  historyDetails().forEach((details, index) => { details.open = expandedBeforePrint[index] || false; });
});

// ---- Security incident: simulated traffic log and answer ----
const incidentLogs = new Map();
const answerHistory = new Map();
const verifiedTransaction = new Map();
let answering = false;

function currentScenario() { return scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value); }

async function showIncident(scenario) {
  $('answer-result').hidden = true;
  const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  if (attempts.length) renderAnswer(attempts[attempts.length - 1]);
  renderAnswerHints(scenario.id);
  if (incidentLogs.has(scenario.id)) { renderLog(scenario.id); return; }
  $('log-body').replaceChildren();
  $('log-note').textContent = 'Loading the simulated capture…';
  try {
    const log = await api(`/api/incident/${encodeURIComponent(scenario.id)}/log`);
    incidentLogs.set(scenario.id, log);
    if (currentScenario()?.id === scenario.id) renderLog(scenario.id);
  } catch (error) {
    $('log-note').textContent = `Could not load the simulated traffic log: ${error.message}`;
  }
}

function renderLog(scenarioId) {
  const log = incidentLogs.get(scenarioId);
  const body = $('log-body');
  body.replaceChildren();
  $('log-note').textContent = `Simulated capture. ${text(log.capture_note, '')}`;
  const flagged = verifiedTransaction.get(scenarioId);
  for (const entry of Array.isArray(log.entries) ? log.entries : []) {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    const seq = addText(row, 'td', text(entry.sequence));
    if (flagged !== undefined && entry.transaction_id === flagged) {
      row.dataset.flag = 'unauthorized';
      row.tabIndex = 0;
      row.setAttribute('aria-label', `Sequence ${text(entry.sequence)}: unauthorized write, verified by your answer`);
      seq.append(document.createElement('br'));
      addText(seq, 'strong', '⚠ Unauthorized write', 'flag');
    }
    const timeCell = document.createElement('td');
    const iso = text(entry.time);
    const clock = /T(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})/.exec(iso);
    if (clock) {
      // Short visible time; the full ISO timestamp is in the title and read by screen readers.
      const time = addText(timeCell, 'time', clock[1]);
      time.dateTime = iso;
      time.title = iso;
      time.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      addText(timeCell, 'span', iso, 'visually-hidden');
    } else {
      timeCell.textContent = iso;
    }
    row.append(timeCell);
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.client));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.transaction_id));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.unit_id));
    addText(row, 'td', `${String(entry.function_code).padStart(2, '0')} · ${text(entry.function_name)}`, 'wrap');
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.address));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.values));
    // Frames open in a full-width row below the entry instead of inside a narrow cell.
    const framesRow = document.createElement('tr');
    framesRow.className = 'frames-row';
    framesRow.id = `log-frames-${text(entry.sequence)}`;
    framesRow.hidden = true;
    const framesCell = document.createElement('td');
    framesCell.colSpan = 9;
    framesRow.append(framesCell);
    const toggleCell = document.createElement('td');
    const toggle = document.createElement('button');
    toggle.type = 'button';
    toggle.className = 'secondary';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls', framesRow.id);
    const setToggleLabel = (open) => {
      toggle.replaceChildren(open ? 'Hide frames' : 'Show frames');
      addText(toggle, 'span', ` for transaction ${text(entry.transaction_id)}`, 'visually-hidden');
    };
    setToggleLabel(false);
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = framesRow.hidden;
      if (open && !framesCell.childElementCount) {
        addText(framesCell, 'p', `Frames for transaction ${text(entry.transaction_id)} (simulated capture)`, 'frames-title');
        const frames = document.createElement('div');
        framesCell.append(frames);
        renderFrames(frames, entry.frames, `log-${entry.sequence}`);
      }
      framesRow.hidden = !open;
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      setToggleLabel(open);
    });
    toggleCell.append(toggle);
    row.append(toggleCell);
    body.append(row, framesRow);
  }
}

// Progressive training hints, kept client-side: none for the first 2 unverified answers,
// hint 1 from the 3rd, hint 2 from the 4th. Hidden once an answer is verified. They never name the row.
const answerHints = [
  'Look at the Function column: which entry changes data instead of reading it?',
  'Compare the value read before and after each entry.',
];
const hintThreshold = 3;

function renderAnswerHints(scenarioId) {
  const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenarioId) || [];
  const wrong = attempts.filter((entry) => entry.verified !== true).length;
  const shown = attempts.some((entry) => entry.verified === true) ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(answerHints.length, wrong - hintThreshold + 1));
  const list = $('answer-hint-list');
  list.replaceChildren();
  answerHints.slice(0, shown).forEach((hint, index) => addText(list, 'li', `Training hint ${index + 1}: ${hint}`));
  $('answer-hints').hidden = shown === 0;
  return shown;
}

function renderAnswer(result) {
  $('answer-result').hidden = false;
  const ok = result.verified === true;
  $('answer-status').textContent = ok ? 'Status: answer verified' : 'Status: answer not verified';
  $('answer-status').dataset.state = ok ? 'success' : 'error';
  for (const key of ['observations', 'possible_causes', 'training_hints', 'next_steps']) fillList($(`answer-${key}`), result[key]);
  const mitigations = Array.isArray(result.mitigations) ? result.mitigations : [];
  $('mitigations-section').hidden = mitigations.length === 0;
  fillList($('answer-mitigations'), mitigations);
  $('answer-verified').textContent = ok ? 'Verified by the simulated capture: this transaction ID and client label match the write.' : 'Not verified by the simulated capture.';
  $('answer-verified').parentElement.dataset.state = ok ? 'success' : '';
  $('answer-explanation').textContent = text(result.explanation, 'No explanation returned.');
  $('answer-explanation-source').textContent = sourceText(result.explanation_source);
}

function renderAnswerHistory() {
  const list = $('answer-history');
  list.replaceChildren();
  const scenario = currentScenario();
  const attempts = scenario ? (answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || []) : [];
  $('answer-history-title').hidden = attempts.length === 0;
  attempts.forEach((entry, index) => {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    addText(details, 'summary', `Answer ${index + 1} · transaction ${text(entry.answer?.transaction_id)} · client ${text(entry.answer?.client)} · ${entry.verified === true ? 'Verified by the simulated capture.' : 'Not verified by the simulated capture.'}`);
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'history-detail';
    for (const [key, label] of [...categories, ['mitigations', 'Next steps · real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation']]) {
      if (key === 'mitigations' && !(entry.mitigations || []).length) continue;
      addText(body, 'h3', label);
      const ul = document.createElement('ul');
      fillList(ul, entry[key]);
      body.append(ul);
    }
    addText(body, 'h3', `Explanation · ${sourceText(entry.explanation_source)}`);
    addText(body, 'p', text(entry.explanation, 'No explanation returned.'));
    details.append(body);
    item.append(details);
    list.append(item);
  });
  if (attempts.length) {
    $('print-report').disabled = false;
    $('history-empty').hidden = true;
  }
}

$('answer-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (answering) return;
  if (!$('answer-form').reportValidity()) return;
  const scenario = currentScenario();
  if (!scenario || scenario.category !== 'security') return;
  const request = { scenario_id: scenario.id, transaction_id: Number($('answer-transaction').value), client: $('answer-client').value.trim() };
  answering = true;
  $('answer-fields').disabled = true;
  // Not `disabled`: a disabled button would drop keyboard focus while the result is announced.
  $('submit-answer').setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  $('test-message').textContent = 'Checking your answer against the simulated capture…';
  try {
    const result = await api('/api/incident/answer', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(request) });
    if (!result.answer) result.answer = request;
    const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
    const hintsBefore = renderAnswerHints(scenario.id);
    attempts.push(result);
    answerHistory.set(scenario.id, attempts);
    if (result.verified === true) verifiedTransaction.set(scenario.id, result.answer.transaction_id);
    renderAnswer(result);
    if (incidentLogs.has(scenario.id)) renderLog(scenario.id);
    renderAnswerHistory();
    const hintsAfter = renderAnswerHints(scenario.id);
    $('test-message').textContent = result.verified === true
      ? 'Answer verified by the simulated capture. The matching log row is now marked "Unauthorized write".'
      : `Answer not verified by the simulated capture. Review the log and try again.${hintsAfter > hintsBefore ? ` Training hint ${hintsAfter}: ${answerHints[hintsAfter - 1]}` : ''}`;
  } catch (error) {
    $('test-message').textContent = `Answer failed: ${error.message}`;
    $('test-message').dataset.state = 'error';
  } finally {
    answering = false;
    $('answer-fields').disabled = false;
    $('submit-answer').removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
  }
});

$('scenario').addEventListener('change', selectScenario);
$('scale').addEventListener('input', validateScale);
for (const field of Object.keys(fieldRules)) $(field).addEventListener('input', () => setInvalid(field, false));

// Guided tour banner for first-time visitors. Dismissal is remembered in localStorage when available.
const tourKey = 'ghostwire.tourDismissed';
const tourScenario = 'unit-id';
function tourDismissed() {
  try { return localStorage.getItem(tourKey) === '1'; } catch { return false; }
}
function showTour() {
  $('tour').hidden = tourDismissed() || !scenarios.some((item) => item.id === tourScenario);
}
$('tour-start').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (running || !scenarios.some((item) => item.id === tourScenario)) return;
  $('scenario').value = tourScenario;
  selectScenario();
  $('test-message').textContent = 'The Silent Sensor is selected. Run the initial simulated read, then inspect the evidence.';
  $('scenario').focus();
});
$('tour-dismiss').addEventListener('click', () => {
  try { localStorage.setItem(tourKey, '1'); } catch { /* Storage unavailable: dismiss for this page only. */ }
  $('tour').hidden = true;
  $('scenario').focus();
});
$('retry-load').addEventListener('click', loadScenarios);
$('print-report').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());
$('test-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (running) return;
  validateScale();
  const problem = requestProblem();
  clearInvalid();
  if (problem) {
    setInvalid(problem.field, true);
    $('test-message').textContent = `${problem.message} Nothing was sent.`;
    $('test-message').dataset.state = 'error';
    $(problem.field).focus();
    return;
  }
  const request = { scenario_id: $('scenario').value };
  for (const field of fields) request[field] = Number($(field).value);
  running = true;
  $('scenario').disabled = true;
  $('request-fields').disabled = true;
  $('run-test').disabled = true;
  $('test-message').textContent = 'Reading the local simulator…';
  $('test-message').dataset.state = '';
  try {
    const result = await api('/api/test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(request) });
    if (!result.request) result.request = request;
    history.push(result);
    caseHistory.set(request.scenario_id, history);
    renderResult(result);
    renderHistory();
    $('run-test').textContent = 'Retest simulated read';
    $('test-message').textContent = 'Read complete. Adjust a setting and retest to compare results.';
  } catch (error) {
    $('test-message').textContent = `Read failed: ${error.message} Check the request and try again.`;
    $('test-message').dataset.state = 'error';
  } finally {
    running = false;
    $('scenario').disabled = false;
    $('request-fields').disabled = false;
    $('run-test').disabled = false;
  }
});

loadScenarios();

// SplitMix64: a small, fully specified PRNG so generated sequences do not depend on System.Random across .NET versions.
sealed class Rng
{
    private ulong state;
    public Rng(ulong seed) { state = seed; }
    public ulong Next()
    {
        ulong z = state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15UL;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9UL;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBUL;
        return z ^ (z >> 31);
    }
    public int NextInt(int min, int maxInclusive) => (int)(min + (long)(Next() % (ulong)((long)maxInclusive - min + 1)));
    public byte[] NextBytes(int length) { var bytes = new byte[length]; for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) bytes[i] = (byte)Next(); return bytes; }
    public T Pick<T>(T[] items) => items[NextInt(0, items.Length - 1)];
}

sealed class PbtCase
{
    public int Index { get; init; }
    public string Input { get; set; } = "(input not recorded)";
}

static class Pbt
{
    public const ulong DefaultSeed = 0x6057_2026;
    public static readonly ulong BaseSeed = ReadSeed();
    public static readonly List<string> Summary = new();

    private static ulong ReadSeed()
    {
        var text = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) return DefaultSeed;
        text = text.Trim();
        if (text.StartsWith("0x", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && ulong.TryParse(text[2..], System.Globalization.NumberStyles.HexNumber, null, out var hex)) return hex;
        if (ulong.TryParse(text, out var dec)) return dec;
        throw new Exception($"GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED must be a decimal or 0x-prefixed hex unsigned integer, got '{text}'");
    }

    private static ulong Fnv1a(string name)
    {
        ulong hash = 0xCBF29CE484222325UL;
        foreach (byte b in System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(name)) { hash ^= b; hash *= 0x100000001B3UL; }
        return hash;
    }

    // generate draws the case input synchronously from the shared Rng (so batching cannot change the sequence)
    // and returns the async check. Cases in a batch run concurrently.
    public static async Task Property(string name, int cases, Func<Rng, PbtCase, Func<Task>> generate, int batch = 1)
    {
        ulong seed = BaseSeed ^ Fnv1a(name);
        var rng = new Rng(seed);
        var watch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        for (int start = 0; start < cases; start += batch)
        {
            var pending = new List<(PbtCase Case, Task Task)>();
            for (int i = start; i < Math.Min(cases, start + batch); i++)
            {
                var c = new PbtCase { Index = i };
                Task task;
                try { var check = generate(rng, c); task = check(); }
                catch (Exception ex) { task = Task.FromException(ex); }
                pending.Add((c, task));
            }
            foreach (var (c, task) in pending)
            {
                try { await task; }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"Property '{name}' failed at case {c.Index} with seed {BaseSeed} (0x{BaseSeed:X}; property seed 0x{seed:X16}): {c.Input}");
                    Console.WriteLine($"Reproduce with GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED={BaseSeed}. Failure: {ex.Message}");
                    throw;
                }
            }
        }
        string line = $"PBT {name}: {cases} cases passed in {watch.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms";
        Summary.Add(line);
        Console.WriteLine(line);
    }
}

sealed class ListRecorder : IExchangeRecorder
{
    private readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentQueue<SimulatorExchange> items = new();
    public bool Throw { get; set; }
    public void Record(SimulatorExchange exchange) { items.Enqueue(exchange); if (Throw) throw new InvalidOperationException("recorder failure"); }
    public SimulatorExchange[] Items => items.ToArray();
    public void Clear() => items.Clear();
    public async Task<SimulatorExchange[]> WaitForAsync(int count, int milliseconds = 1000)
    {
        var watch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        while (items.Count < count && watch.ElapsedMilliseconds < milliseconds) await Task.Delay(2);
        return Items;
    }
}

    ("{\"scenario_id\":\"phantom-writer\",\"transaction_id\":70000,\"client\":\"MAINT-LAPTOP-07\"}", "transaction_id out of range"),
    ("{\"scenario_id\":\"phantom-writer\",\"transaction_id\":\"1111\",\"client\":\"MAINT-LAPTOP-07\"}", "transaction_id as string"),
    ("{\"scenario_id\":\"phantom-writer\",\"transaction_id\":1111,\"client\":\"a b\"}", "client with a space"),
    ("{\"scenario_id\":\"phantom-writer\",\"transaction_id\":1111,\"client\":\"" + new string('A', 33) + "\"}", "33-character client"),
    ("not json", "invalid JSON"),
})
{
    var invalidAnswer = await Answer(new StringContent(body, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
    Check(invalidAnswer.Status == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest && invalidAnswer.Body.TryGetProperty("error", out _), $"answer rejects {name}");
}
Check((await Answer(new StringContent("{}", Encoding.UTF8, "text/plain"))).Status == HttpStatusCode.UnsupportedMediaType, "answer rejects text/plain");
using (var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/api/incident/answer") { Content = AnswerJson(1111, "MAINT-LAPTOP-07") })
{
    request.Headers.Add("Origin", "http://evil.example");
    using var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
    Check(response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, "answer rejects cross-origin");
}
using (var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "/api/incident/phantom-writer/log"))
{
    request.Headers.Host = "evil.example";
    using var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
    Check(response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, "log rejects foreign host");
}
using (var oversizedClient = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(address) })
{
    // Kestrel may reset the connection before the client finishes sending 16 KiB+; that is also a rejection.
    bool rejected;
    try { using var response = await oversizedClient.PostAsync("/api/incident/answer", new StringContent(new string('x', 16385), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")); rejected = (int)response.StatusCode is 400 or 413; }
    catch (HttpRequestException) { rejected = true; }
    Check(rejected, "answer rejects oversized request");
}
using (var invalid = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/test", new { scenario_id = "unit-id", unit_id = 17, function_code = 4, address = 0, quantity = 1, scale = 1, host = "example.com" })) Check(invalid.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, "reject unknown target");

using (var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/api/test") { Content = JsonContent.Create(P("unit-id",17,4,0,1,1)) })
{

}
using (var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "/api/scenarios"))
{

    using var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
    Check(response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, "reject host");
}
using (var response = await client.PostAsync("/api/test", new StringContent(new string('x', 16385), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"))) Check((int)response.StatusCode is 400 or 413, "reject oversized request");
var providerBuilder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder();
providerBuilder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(o => o.Listen(IPAddress.Loopback, 0));
await using var provider = providerBuilder.Build();
bool oversizedProviderResponse = false;

{

});

bool rateLimited = false;

await app.StopAsync();

Console.WriteLine($"PBT seed used: {Pbt.BaseSeed}");

// SplitMix64: a small, fully specified PRNG so generated sequences do not depend on System.Random across .NET versions.
sealed class Rng
{
    private ulong state;
    public Rng(ulong seed) { state = seed; }
    public ulong Next()
    {
        ulong z = state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15UL;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9UL;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBUL;
        return z ^ (z >> 31);
    }
    public int NextInt(int min, int maxInclusive) => (int)(min + (long)(Next() % (ulong)((long)maxInclusive - min + 1)));
    public byte[] NextBytes(int length) { var bytes = new byte[length]; for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) bytes[i] = (byte)Next(); return bytes; }
    public T Pick<T>(T[] items) => items[NextInt(0, items.Length - 1)];
}

sealed class PbtCase
{
    public int Index { get; init; }
    public string Input { get; set; } = "(input not recorded)";
}

static class Pbt
{
    public const ulong DefaultSeed = 0x6057_2026;
    public static readonly ulong BaseSeed = ReadSeed();
    public static readonly List<string> Summary = new();

    private static ulong ReadSeed()
    {
        var text = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) return DefaultSeed;
        text = text.Trim();
        if (text.StartsWith("0x", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && ulong.TryParse(text[2..], System.Globalization.NumberStyles.HexNumber, null, out var hex)) return hex;
        if (ulong.TryParse(text, out var dec)) return dec;
        throw new Exception($"GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED must be a decimal or 0x-prefixed hex unsigned integer, got '{text}'");
    }

    private static ulong Fnv1a(string name)
    {
        ulong hash = 0xCBF29CE484222325UL;
        foreach (byte b in System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(name)) { hash ^= b; hash *= 0x100000001B3UL; }
        return hash;
    }

    // generate draws the case input synchronously from the shared Rng (so batching cannot change the sequence)
    // and returns the async check. Cases in a batch run concurrently.
    public static async Task Property(string name, int cases, Func<Rng, PbtCase, Func<Task>> generate, int batch = 1)
    {
        ulong seed = BaseSeed ^ Fnv1a(name);
        var rng = new Rng(seed);
        var watch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        for (int start = 0; start < cases; start += batch)
        {
            var pending = new List<(PbtCase Case, Task Task)>();
            for (int i = start; i < Math.Min(cases, start + batch); i++)
            {
                var c = new PbtCase { Index = i };
                Task task;
                try { var check = generate(rng, c); task = check(); }
                catch (Exception ex) { task = Task.FromException(ex); }
                pending.Add((c, task));
            }
            foreach (var (c, task) in pending)
            {
                try { await task; }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"Property '{name}' failed at case {c.Index} with seed {BaseSeed} (0x{BaseSeed:X}; property seed 0x{seed:X16}): {c.Input}");
                    Console.WriteLine($"Reproduce with GHOSTWIRE_PBT_SEED={BaseSeed}. Failure: {ex.Message}");
                    throw;
                }
            }
        }
        string line = $"PBT {name}: {cases} cases passed in {watch.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms";
        Summary.Add(line);
        Console.WriteLine(line);
    }
}

sealed class ListRecorder : IExchangeRecorder
{
    private readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentQueue<SimulatorExchange> items = new();
    public bool Throw { get; set; }
    public void Record(SimulatorExchange exchange) { items.Enqueue(exchange); if (Throw) throw new InvalidOperationException("recorder failure"); }
    public SimulatorExchange[] Items => items.ToArray();
    public void Clear() => items.Clear();
    public async Task<SimulatorExchange[]> WaitForAsync(int count, int milliseconds = 1000)
    {
        var watch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        while (items.Count < count && watch.ElapsedMilliseconds < milliseconds) await Task.Delay(2);
        return Items;
    }
}

static class CheckCount { public static int Passed; }

<file name="docs/judge-quick-start.md" language="markdown" >
<content>
# Judge quick start

1. From the project root, run `dotnet run --project csharp/GhostWire/GhostWire.csproj` with the .NET 8 SDK. Alternatively, unzip the Windows release package, which requires the .NET 8 ASP.NET Core Runtime (x64), and run `GhostWire.exe`.
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:8000. No login, physical PLC, sensor or AI key is required for the core simulation. The case picker groups **Troubleshooting** and **Security incidents** and shows each case's difficulty. On a first visit a **Guided tour** banner suggests starting with The Silent Sensor, then Phantom Writer; its button selects The Silent Sensor, and **Dismiss** hides it for this browser. If a read setting is out of range (for example Unit ID 999), nothing is sent and a message names the allowed range.
3. Select **The Giant Pressure** and run the read. Inspect raw 39 and the simulated documentation. Set the scale to 0.01 and retest: the displayed result is 0.39 bar.
4. Open **Wire evidence (simulated frames)** under the verification line. The request is `00 01 00 00 00 06 07 03 00 0A 00 01` and the response is `00 01 00 00 00 05 07 03 02 00 27`. Tab to a field row, or hover it, to highlight its bytes; the row also states the byte range in text (for example "bytes 0–1" for the transaction ID). The panel defines MBAP header, PDU, unit ID and function code. Wire evidence is available after every read in every case, including Phantom Writer's initial read.
5. Select **The Silent Sensor**, run the initial read, inspect the timeout and possible causes. Wire evidence shows only the request frame (`00 01 00 00 00 06 01 04 00 00 00 01`) because no response arrived. Check the simulated documentation, set Unit ID to 17 and retest: the simulator returns raw 73 and the read is verified. The timeout alone did not prove the unit ID was the cause; the successful retest with 17 is what verifies the setting.
6. Select **The Wrong Register**, run the read and open Wire evidence: the response `00 01 00 00 00 03 03 84 02` decodes as function `84 · Exception for 04` and exception code `02 · Illegal Data Address`. Compare address 21 to the simulated zero-based map at 20, then retest with 20: the simulator returns raw 125 and the read is verified.
7. Select **Phantom Writer** (security, intermediate) and run the initial read (unit 5, function 03, address 100, quantity 1, scale 0.1). The simulator returns raw 950, shown as 95 °C, while the simulated documentation states a normal setpoint of 650 (65.0 °C). The read verifies the current simulated setpoint, not who changed it.
8. In **Simulated traffic log**, review the 12 captured transactions. Identify the entry that changed the setpoint: its simulated time, client label, transaction ID, unit ID, register and old and new value. Times show as HH:MM:SS (UTC); hover a time, or use a screen reader, for the full timestamp. Press **Show frames** on a row to see its bytes. On a narrow screen the table scrolls sideways inside its own box. Type the transaction ID and client label of that entry into the answer form, then press **Submit answer**. After 3 answers that are not verified, a training hint appears under the form, and a second one after the 4th. The hints never name the entry.
9. Expected verified outcome: transaction 1111 at 2026-10-31T02:13:33Z from client label MAINT-LAPTOP-07 is function 06 (Write Single Register) to unit 5, register 100, value 950; the last read before it (transaction 7) returned 650 and the next read (transaction 8) returned 950. The row is then marked "⚠ Unauthorized write", and four mitigations appear under "Next steps · real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation". A wrong pair returns "not verified" without revealing the correct one.
10. Inspect observations, hypotheses, training hints, verification and case history (reads and answer attempts). The report can be printed via the browser.

All devices and measurements are simulated. The server is limited to loopback; it cannot test or write real equipment. Learners cannot send Modbus writes; the Phantom Writer FC06 happens only inside the server's private simulator at startup. Modbus TCP frames carry no client identity, so client labels are capture metadata. Mitigations are guidance and are not verified by this simulation. Timeout is not proof of a particular cause. External AI is optional and may be wrong.

</content>
</file>
